pages.text: Makes the coolants that let a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) run at higher power. Uses $(l)20 FE/t$(); each batch takes 2 seconds and makes $(l)500 mB$().$(br2)It is a small multiblock: $(l)place a Cyber Frame on its right$(),

seen from its front, against the open flange. $(l)Right-click$() the machine and sparks show the spot (hold sneak to place the frame against the machine itself). When the frame is there the machine assembles and opens, and both tanks show their levels. It does not work until then, so a Mixer placed before this change waits for
its frame, with its contents kept.$(br)$(li)$(l)Water$(): Lapis Lazuli, $(l)Coolant$()$(br)$(li)$(l)Coolant$(): Blue Ice, $(l)Cryo Coolant$()

$(li)Pipe the fluid in (water from a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l), or Coolant to upgrade it), put the items in the slot by hand or with a hopper. Pipes and hoppers connect to the machine's half of the bench only, on its left side, front or back.

$(li)The left tank shows what goes in, the right one what comes out. Breaking the frame folds the bench back and stops it; put a frame back and it opens again.$(br)$(li)The result is pushed into adjacent pipes and tanks by itself: pipe it to a $(l)Reactor Port$().
$(li)$(l)Fill a bucket$(): right-click the Coolant Mixer (or any tank holding at least 1,000 mB of coolant) with an $(l)empty bucket$().
pages.title: Buckets and pools

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Empty it$(): right-click a Reactor Port or tank to pour it in, or anywhere else to pour a $(l)pool$() of coolant, just like water. An empty bucket scoops it back up.$(br)$(li)$(l)Careful$(): coolant is thick and freezing cold. Wading through a pool slows you down, and the longer you

$(li)stay, the more frost covers the screen; once fully frozen you take damage. $(l)Cryo Coolant$() slows you more and freezes you about four times faster. As in powder snow, $(l)leather armor$() keeps the cold out (but not the slowdown).$(br)$(li)$(item)Coolant Bucket$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Cryo Coolant Bucket$()

The coolant fills the reactor's $(l)primary loop$() and decides how much heat can leave the core each tick: 200 with plain water, $(l)500$() with Coolant, $(l)1,200$() with Cryo Coolant. It is not used up like the water, but wears out slowly: 1 mB for every 400 heat it moves.
